results.reason: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + rear-limb and head/wing crops. A living leopard with one feline head (rounded ears, spotted tawny fur, open snarl — not a griffin beak), two eyes, and exactly two huge feathered griffin wings at the shoulders (c02/c04). All four legs separately traceable: two front legs reaching forward with long claws, two hind legs trailing back-left with both paws visible, and one long spotted tufted tail curling up-left — no extra or merged limbs. Mid-air lunge from a dark rock ledge toward the viewer throwing physical dust; no invented lust power, victim, aura, text or borrowed design. Dominates the frame and reads as a winged leopard at 200px. c02/c04 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + leg and body crops. One normal-sized dark wet horse (c01): one head, two eyes, one mane, one tail, and exactly four legs — two front legs planted on the near pond bank and two hind legs kicking up over the water in a vicious buck (no horns, wings or extra anatomy). It twists its neck toward the viewer with an open nickering/laughing mouth and natural horse teeth while an opaque, fully-clothed adult rider is thrown headlong into the middle of the moonlit pond, head and shoulders entering the splash (c05/c06). Northumbrian rural pond at night with a full moon and stone wall (c01/c06); the horse dominates ~2/3 of the frame. Saddle/stirrup are editorial only. No gore, text or aura.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + face, rider and leg crops. One enormous bird with exactly one mature, solemn HUMAN face (two human eyes, human nose, closed human mouth — no beak, no second face) on a feathered neck/body (c01/c07), two spread feathered wings, two scaled bird legs with taloned feet, and a feathered tail. One fully-clothed crowned prince sits securely on its back with no weapon (c04). Sweeping down in flight over a broad moonlit field (c04); physical streaming feathers, no prophecy symbols, aura or text. Noble benevolent awe rather than horror; dominates the frame at 200px. c01/c07/c02/c04 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + face crop. Viewed native 1254px + 200px + paw crops. One realistic raccoon-dog tanuki with a natural dark eye-mask, two ears, two natural (non-glowing) eyes, a snarling open mouth, four legs (front paw stamping the foreground, others planted/under the body — no extra limbs) and one bushy raised tail; no clothes or enlarged body (c01/c03). An isolated transverse wall-illusion crosses the middle of the footpath with abrupt ends, the path visible before it and continuing beyond, its far-right end rippled like heat-haze (the mirage edge); a fully-clothed traveller recoils with a hand against it, interrupted mid-stride (c04/c06). Natural animal size set by path leaves; moonlit Sado night footpath near Aikawa (c01/c08). No glow, ground-eruption, energy ribbons, text or aura. Uncanny guardian actively closing the path.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + face and hand crops. One beautiful adult woman with a clearly metallic, riveted iron nose-sheath, two eyes, and two hands each bearing long curved iron fingernails (five per hand, about ten total), in a fully opaque weathered dark dress and shawl (c04). She lunges from forest shadow screaming toward the viewer while a distant, fully-clothed adult clutches his ears — the maddening cry shown as an effect, not as energy or sound beams (c01/c09). Dry pine mountain forest of Bigadic at sunset with no water present (c01/c07). The subject fills ~80% with low-angle foreshortening; no aura, text or borrowed design. c04/c01/c09/c07 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + head crop. A monumental anthropomorphic deity with one frog head (two amphibian eyes, a wide frog mouth) on a large body, two arms, and both hands lifting aloft one large plain solar disc (c06); opaque Egyptian usekh collar and linen kilt, lower legs submerged. Primordial black waters surge around him and a dark mound of first land rises beneath; warm light comes from the supported sun disc, not a generic aura (c03/c07). Reverent cosmic awe appropriate to a deity; no readable hieroglyphic lettering and no borrowed design. Dominates the frame at 200px. c06/c03/c07 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + multiple leg crops (left-half, right-half and a tight central-gap crop at high zoom) plus a wing crop. The body is a smooth rounded yellow sack flushed cinnabar red with absolutely NO head, face, eyes or mouth (c02/c07). I independently counted EXACTLY SIX feet along the lower body — two foreshortened front feet, one behind between them, two under the mid/rear body (resolvable only in the tight gap crop, where a lower-resolution view merges them) and one far-right foot planted on the crag — and EXACTLY FOUR distinct feathered wings (two per side at different heights with clear gaps); no tail. A dancing bounding turn over dark mineral crags with jade-green stones at sunset; cinnabar surface caught by the light, no invented powers, aura or text (c01/c06/c07). A faceless uncanny guardian, awe-inspiring at 200px. c02/c06/c07 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + head crop. One sacred raven transforming into a man: the black raven head/beak is tilted up like a HOOD above a single wise human face with two natural human eyes (the one visible raven eye belongs to the lifted hood, not an extra human eye). Two human hands lift the hood from the sides and two arms take the place of wings — no separate extra wings (c03). Fully opaque black feather cloak; legs hidden in the surf. He rises from primordial water as a mass of first land pushes up through the moving sea beneath him (c02), on an Arctic coast with snowy peaks and a golden sunset (c04). Reverent, dignified awe; an original representation, not copied sacred bark art; no gore, beams, glyphs, text or aura. c02/c03/c04 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + face and lower-body crops. Viewed native 1254px + 200px + head crop. Only a single hideous rooster HEAD — no bird body, wings or legs — built visibly from tangled off-white/grey/ochre pillow wool and feathers: a hooked beak open in silent menace, a coarse fibrous comb, hanging wool-wattle shapes and two recessed dark avian eyes, all clearly made of twisted stuffing rather than a normal red-skinned rooster (c04). It pushes out of a torn pillow seam with cotton spilling out, filling most of the frame in a dark hearth-lit bedroom at night (c02/c04). No child/victim, disease mist/rays, text or aura. Profoundly uncanny, not cute. c04/c01/c02 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + head crop. One immense dragon-shaped serpentine monster: one elongated scaled reptilian head with two natural (non-glowing) eyes and a forked tongue, a long heavy coiling scaled body and one continuous tail — limbless, with no wings, horns, antlers, spikes, whiskers, extra heads or icons (c01). It rears above the viewer and drives forward, head bending down in a threatening hiss, as the field physically withers and BURNS in its wake: blackened stubble, low natural orange flames, cracked drought soil, dust and heat shimmer — no fire-beam, lightning or aura (c04/c05). Devastated Korean farmland at low sun; the burn/drought tradition, excluding the foal and heavy-rain variants. Mythic disaster scale, not an ordinary snake. c01/c04/c05 satisfied.

Viewed native 1254px + 200px + hand, leg and membrane crops. One humanoid spirit-man with one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; broad loose folds of skin hang ALONG the arms and legs and open into draping winglike flaps attached to those four limbs — no separate added bat wings (c02/c06). Both hands show five digits (thumb + four fingers) and a bare five-toed foot is clearly separate. An opaque dark woven wrap fully covers the torso and pelvis. No victim, smothering, feeding, gore, invented sacred markings, text or aura; a respectful original representation. Uncanny awe, dominates the frame at 200px. c02/c06/c03/c04/c01 satisfied.
